-  #define UPDATE_DEFAULT_DEP(flag, dep0, ...)                           \
-  UPDATE_DEFAULT(flag)                                                 \
-  void validate_flag() {                                               \
-    DEBUG_ONLY(verify_deps(dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__));                        \
-    if (flag && !deps_all_flags_enabled(dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__)) {         \
-      FLAG_SET_DEFAULT(flag, false);                                   \
-      stringStream ss;                                                 \
-      ss.print("missing dependent extension(s): ");                     \
-      deps_flags_string(ss, dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__);                       \
-      log_disabled(ss.base());                                         \
-    }                                                                  \
-  }                                                                    \
-
-  #define NO_UPDATE_DEFAULT                \
-  void update_flag() {}                    \
-  void update_feature() {}                 \
+  #define DEFINE_FEATURE_METHODS(flag) \
+  bool flag_enabled() { return flag; } \
+  void update_flag() {                 \
+    if (!enabled()) {                  \
+      FLAG_SET_ERGO(flag, false);      \
+      return;                          \
+    }                                  \
+    if (FLAG_IS_DEFAULT(flag)) {       \
+      FLAG_SET_DEFAULT(flag, true);    \
+    }                                  \
+  }                                    \
+  void update_feature() {              \
+    if (flag) {                        \
+      enable_feature();                \
+    } else {                           \
+      disable_feature();               \
+    }                                  \
+  }                                    \
+
+  #define DEFINE_FEATURE_METHODS_DEP(flag, dep0, ...)           \
+  DEFINE_FEATURE_METHODS(flag)                                  \
+  void validate_flag() {                                        \
+    DEBUG_ONLY(verify_deps(dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__));               \
+    if (flag && !deps_all_flags_enabled(dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__)) { \
+      FLAG_SET_DEFAULT(flag, false);                            \
+      stringStream ss;                                          \
+      ss.print("missing dependent extension(s): ");             \
+      deps_flags_string(ss, dep0, ##__VA_ARGS__);               \
+      log_disabled(ss.base());                                  \
+    }                                                           \
+  }                                                             \
+
+  #define DEFINE_NOOP_FEATURE_METHODS \
+  void update_flag() {}               \
+  void update_feature() {}            \
